name: Avernalis
body:
Avernalis (Lampad Queen) CR 17

Surrounded by eerie lights, this tall, beautiful silver-haired woman seems to own the deep caverns around, a somber expression on her exquisite features.

XP 102,400
CN Medium fey (earth)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 90 ft., low-light vision, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +40; Aura insane beauty (30 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 32, touch 25, flat-footed 24 (+7 deflection, +7 Dex, +1 dodge, +7 natural)
hp 266 (28d6+168); fast healing 5
Fort +15, Ref +23, Will +21
DR 10/cold iron; Resist acid 30, cold 30, electricity 30

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +2 dagger +23/+18 (1d4+3/19-20)
Ranged +2 sling +23/+18 (1d4+3)
Special Attacks weep
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 28th; concentration +35)

Constant—stone tell
At will—dancing lights, meld into stone
8/day—cavesight
5/day—magic missile
3/day—crushing despair (DC 19)

Druid Spells Prepared (CL 17th; concentration +22)

9th Level—elemental swarm, imprisonmentD
8th level—earthquakeD (DC 25), repel metal or stone, reverse gravity
7th level—mass cure moderate wounds, statueD, summon nature’s ally VII, tectonic communion
6th level—conjure black pudding D, find the path, mass binding earth (DC 23), move earth
5th level—cave fangs (DC 22), darkvault, stoneskin, transmute rock to mud (DC 22), transmute mud to rock (DC 22), wall of stoneD (DC 22)
4th level—cure serious wounds, earth glide, echolocation, kiss of the First World, see through stone, spike stones (DC 21)
3rd level—cure moderate wounds, dark-light, deeper darknessD, earth tremor, soothing mud, stone shape
2nd level—chill metal, lay of the land, , pale flameD, soften earth and stone, spider climb, stone call,D
1st level—blend with surroundings (DC 16), cure light wounds, detect aberration D, detect radiation, echo (DC 16), faerie fire, magic stone
0th-Level—detect magic, detect poison, light, mending

Domain Cave

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 25, Con 22, Int 18, Wis 21, Cha 25
Base Atk +14; CMB +15; CMD 32
Feats Alertness, Arc Slinger, Combat Casting, Dodge, Elemental Focus (earth), Greater Elemental Focus (earth), Mobility, Piranha Strike, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Stealthy, Tenebrous Spell, Umbral Spell, Weapon Finesse
Skills Diplomacy +38, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +32, Knowledge (nature) +35, Linguistics +32, Perception +40, Perform (sing) +38, Sense Motive +40, Spellcraft +32, Stealth +42, Use Magic Device +38
Languages Aklo, Common, Undercommon; stone tell, tongues
SQ guarded

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Domain An avernalis has access to the powers and domain spells of the Cave domain as a 17th-level druid.

Guarded (Su)

An avernalis adds her Charisma modifier as a deflection bonus to her armor class.

Insane Beauty (Su)

This ability affects all humanoids within 30 feet who are viewing an avernalis in conditions brighter than dim light. Those who look directly upon the avernalis must succeed at a DC 31 Will save or gain the confused condition for 1d10 rounds. A creature that succeeds at the save is immune to the same avernalis’ insane beauty for 24 hours. An avernalis can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Spells An avernalis casts spells as a 17th-level druid but can’t swap out prepared spells to cast summon spells.

Weep (Su)

As a standard action, an avernalis can unsettle those near her when she cries. Any creature within 30 feet who can hear an avernalis weeping becomes shaken for 2d8 rounds unless it succeeds at a DC 31 Will saving throw. A shaken creature under the effect of this ability becomes frightened, and a frightened creature becomes panicked. This is a mind-affecting fear effect that relies on audible components. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground
Organization solitary, retinue (1 plus 1-4 lampads), or court (1-4 plus 2-10 dire bats, 1-8 lampads, 2-8 pech, and 1-2 greater earth elementals)
Treasure triple (+2 dagger, +2 sling, other treasure)

Like a hamadryad reigns on an entire forest, an avernalis is the queen of a vast cavern system underground, revered by the lampads in their area and other subterranean creatures.

Though lampads are solitary creatures by nature, they gather around avernales in the rare occasions when they need to exchange information or just alleviate their solitude with the company of their kin, telling each other tragic stories and singing saddening songs together. Few mortals have ever seen an avernalis or her court, and these few have returned home bearing other great blessings or great curses.

Avernales heal wounded or ill underground creatures and protect the natural beauty of their realms from intruders and defilers; though they don’t like anyone to venture too deep in their caves, lampad queens particularly loathe evil influences like those of the drow or duergar, and may ally with dwarves and other good subterranean races in order to cleanse a region of malevolent presences.

Avernales are respected and searched as guardians of deep knowledge and lost treasures from ancient times.

It is said that they know everything that transpires in their guarded caverns. The well-being of a cave system depends on its queen’s health; if she is unwell, it becomes a dangerous place infested by disease, oozes, and aberrations, but if the avernalis is restored, the caves become a safe place to pass through again.
